description:
Outcome: Coordinator sees all plots and their holders (brief.md: First version must 5).
Scope: Responsive schematic 40-plot grid, labels, vacancies/holders, season selector and accessible list equivalent. Excludes: GIS and gardener access.
Acceptance: Exactly 40 plots represented; displayed holders agree with stored allocations after correction; availability not colour-only.
Behaviour: Empty season, load failures and responsive navigation. Large text and plain language; phone layout, labelled controls, keyboard/focus support and explicit empty/loading/error/success states. Preserve input on failure and permit retries without duplicate writes; enforce permissions on server.
Verification: Populated/vacant fixtures, coordinator-only requests, keyboard and phone tests. Prerequisites: T-007, T-003. Assumptions: actual plot arrangement supplied by coordinator.
title: Show coordinator 40-plot map
